name: Senpai Oshiete Kudasai! ~Eroge o Kashita no wa Koukishin Ousei na You-kya Kouhai Deshita~
original_name: 先輩教えてください！ ～エロゲを貸したのは好奇心旺盛な陽キャ後輩でした～
source:
Kudou Souichi is a member of the game research club at his university.
One day, I ended up lending a “dating simulation game” to Kazuha Takamura, a popular junior in my club.
However, Souichi accidentally gave her an “erotic game”…
Souichi braced himself for the worst possible misunderstanding, but Kazuha’s reaction was completely unexpected.

“That game was so much fun!”
And so the story began with a mishap involving “Souichi” and his outgoing junior, “Kazuha,” who has a strange sense of personal space.
translation:
工藤总一是他所在大学的游戏研究俱乐部的成员。
有一天，我最终把一款“约会模拟游戏”借给了高村和叶，他是我们俱乐部里一位受欢迎的后辈。
然而，宗一不小心给了她一个“色情游戏”……
宗一做好了应对最严重误会的准备，但一叶的反应却完全出乎意料。

“那场比赛真是太有趣了！”
故事就这样从一场涉及“宗一”和他即将离任的后辈“一叶”的事故开始，“一叶”对个人空间有着奇怪的感觉。
